claude.name: web_search
claude.description: Search the web and get the results as text with their links. Say what you need with the parameters (a topic, how deep, how much text); the search best at it serves the call.

query.description: What to search for, in words.

recency.description: Only results published within the last day, week, month or year.

date_from.description: Only results published on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

date_to.description: Only results published on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

exclude_domains.description: Leave out results from these sites.

country.description: Results for this country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, such as US).

language.description: Results in this language (ISO 639-1, such as en).

topic.description: What kind of results you need (default general).

engine.description: Results as this search engine ranks them (default any).

depth.description: How hard to search: quick, balanced (default) or thorough (slower, more sources).

objective.description: What you want to find out, in a sentence, to rank the results by.

content.description: How much of each page: none, a snippet (default), the most relevant highlights, or the full text.

answer.description: Also write a short answer from the results.

similar_to.description: Find pages like this one (a URL).

snapshot_date.description: Search the web as it looked on this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

domains_mode.description: With include_domains: only those sites (default), or prefer them.

location.description: A city or address, for local results.

claude.name: web_extract
claude.description: Read web pages (or PDF and Word files) and get their text.

urls.description: The pages to read (1 to 10 URLs).

focus.description: Return only what is relevant to this.

render.description: Run the page's scripts first (javascript), or not (static); default auto.

protected.description: The pages block bots: read them the way a browser would.

actions.description: Click, scroll, wait or fill before reading.

schema.description: Return these fields (a JSON Schema) instead of the text.

summary.description: Return a summary of each page.

freshness.description: A recent copy is fine (default), or read the live page.

snapshot_date.description: The page as it was on this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

screenshot.description: Also take a screenshot of each page.

job_id.description: The job_id an earlier call of this tool answered: wait for that job and get its result (no other arguments needed).

claude.name: web_crawl
claude.description: Follow the links of a site from one page and read the pages found.

include_paths.description: Only pages whose path matches one of these.

exclude_paths.description: Leave out pages whose path matches one of these.

map_only.description: Only list the pages, without their text.

render.description: Run each page's scripts first (javascript), or not (static); default auto.

job_id.description: The job_id an earlier call of this tool answered: wait for that job and get its result (no other arguments needed).

claude.name: web_research
claude.description: Research a question on the web and get a cited report.

recency.description: Only sources from the last day, week, month or year.

depth.description: quick, standard (default) or deep (slower, more sources).

output.description: What to return: a report (default), a short answer, structured fields, a list of entities, or a decision.

schema.description: The fields to return (a JSON Schema), with output structured.

files.description: Files to read too (PDF, CSV, XLSX URLs).

job_id.description: The job_id an earlier call of this tool answered: wait for that job and get its result (no other arguments needed).
